project.name: Sky & Sea 3D — Ambient Study & Focus Sanctuary
project.description: A procedural 3D ambient study sanctuary with cinematic oceans and cloud islands, synthesized Web Audio soundscapes, long-form YouTube music, a Pomodoro ritual, and a portable local study log.

usage.note: Final snapshot taken from the OpenCode session record after GitHub publication and live Pages verification, immediately before the final state commit. That final commit adds only a marginal number of tokens.

features: Ocean Drift shader ocean with five wave fields, Fresnel reflection, sun glints, foam and bioluminescence
SkyCraft Soar volumetric-style cloud sea, five floating islands, forests, ruins, crystals and birds
Four interpolated atmosphere presets: Golden Sunset, Moonlit Bioluminescent Night, Misty Morning Dawn, Deep Dusk
Zero-input cinematic auto-pilot camera with temporary manual orbit control
Four-layer procedural Web Audio soundscape: ocean surf, soft rain, wind chimes and 432 Hz binaural focus tone
Persistent volume mixer, mute and synthesized completion chimes
25/5 Pomodoro timer with pause/resume, reset, skip, auto-break, cycle dots and wall-clock accuracy
Long-form YouTube music drawer with four curated streams and custom URL support
localStorage study log, JSON export and validated JSON import
Hide UI mode with keyboard, click and touch restore
Responsive glassmorphic desktop, tablet and mobile interface
16-check browser self-test surface and WebGL fallback
runtimeDependencies: Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono (SIL OFL 1.1)

checks: All four atmosphere presets and interpolation
Auto-pilot camera active with finite coordinates
Timer start, pause, focus completion, auto-break and restored timer state
Sound graph construction, four channels, master volume, mute and persistence
Downloaded focus_sanctuary_log.json and validated synthetic File import
Keyboard shortcuts H, 2, O and Space
YouTube long-form embed loaded in the player
Mobile 390x844 layout, four dock buttons, bottom-sheet panels and touch restore chip
No uncaught exceptions or application console errors
